Abstract

We investigate the dynamics of massive test particles around a static black hole in nonlocal gravity and examine the corresponding properties of high-frequency quasi-periodic oscillations (HF QPOs), constraining the nonlocal parameter to \alpha /M \le 0.452. We show that the nonlocal parameter \alpha enhances the effective potential V_{\text {eff}} and leads to a systematic reduction in the energy \mathcal {E} and angular momentum \mathcal {L} of circular orbits.
